subject: hela
label: Eleven inches, unused
to: 11" — and she does not top with it
note:
Second longest in the canon after Bryn's 11.5", carried by a woman who bottoms. In her own words it is “FOR LEAKING, BOUNCING, AND LETTING MY DUMBASS GIRLFRIEND KNOW WHEN I'M HORNY AND NEED HER DICK.” A signal flare rather than an instrument.

She is also ONE OF FOUR SURVIVORS of the Pleasures subflight — the one Ivy was being held in reserve to replace after it died.
